projects.name: Apple ServiceTalk Contributions
projects.summary: Contributions to Apple's ServiceTalk Java networking framework, spanning buffer APIs, DNS discovery correctness, HTTP request metadata, and gRPC error handling.
highlights: PR #3696 adds a public Buffer.toByteArray API, migrates serializers and Jersey callers, and reports 1,027 tests across ten affected modules.
PR #3694 adds deterministic DNS observer and polling regressions across second boundaries; the author reports 40,446 repository-wide test cases passing.
PR #3697 populates http/https schemes for single-address client requests based on SSL configuration.
Merged PR #3695 demonstrates application exception mapping to gRPC INVALID_ARGUMENT responses with BadRequest details.

projects.name: PatrolLens
projects.summary: An AI-powered evidence investigation system for law-enforcement bodycam footage with multimodal search and timestamped event retrieval.
highlights: Combines multimodal search with timestamped event retrieval for evidence investigation.
The public repository documents the system's investigation workflow and implementation.

projects.name: Queuemaxxing
projects.summary: A durable Go work queue with a PostgreSQL CDC connector, replication buffering, and local crash-recovery support.
highlights: Implements durable queue processing and PostgreSQL change-data-capture integration in one local binary.
Focuses on buffering, persistence, and recovery without requiring AWS infrastructure.

projects.name: OpsBook Real-Time Booking Platform
projects.summary: A real-time booking operations platform using ASP.NET Core SignalR, Redis-cached MVC pages, idempotent payment workflows, and automated tests.
highlights: Uses SignalR push delivery for real-time updates instead of polling.
Includes Redis response caching, idempotent payment workflows, and 47 MSTest tests as documented in the public repository.
